Domination is without question the most dangerous art within Achaea. It involves the summoning of entities from the [[Chaos Plane]] as well as [[Chaos Lords]]. A practitioner risks their life and very soul in dealing with them, for they are powerful and not to be trifled with. To gain the services of a [[Chaos entities|Chaos Entity]], one must first discover a way into the Chaos Plane. Once there, search them out and attempt to dominate them.

Though once connected with the Chaos Plane, [[Taug|Lord Taug]], also known as [[Pazuzu|Prince Pazuzu]] is no longer welcome there, and thus bargains can no longer be made with this [[Chaos Lords]] through the abilities of Domination.

It should also be noted that although wielding the recondite magicks of the occultist
has historically been regarded as an altogether laissez faire matter (save by the [[Church]]), since the rise of the [[Glaaki|Imperator]] and closer ties of the Chaos Court with the [[Prime Material Plane|Prime]], power rests with the [[Ruinous Intercessor of Interplanar Dominion]] to [[exile]] any cabalist who would use his or her discordant talents against the [[Ashtan|Seat of Chaos]].

The skill of '''Domination''' is available to members of the [[Occultist]] [[class]], along with [[Occultism]] and [[Tarot]].

{{Skill_detail

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=[[Pyradius]]
 |description=Pyradius, the firelord.

 |syntax=COMMAND FIRELORD AT <target> <affliction>

 |cooldown=3.00 seconds of entity balance
 |detail=Pyradius will send his firelords to assist you. These Chaotic minions have the power to convert the afflictions your enemies labour into other conditions:

- Whisperingmadness becomes recklessness.

- Manaleech becomes anorexia.

- Healthleech becomes psychic damage (this does not cure the
healthleech).

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Primebond
 |description=Agency upon the Prime.
 |lessons=356
 |syntax=PRIMEBOND<br>PRIMEBOND FORM <chaos lord><br>PRIMEBOND SEVER <chaos lord>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=The minions the Chaos Court will send to you are limited in their agency given the constraints they labour under. No matter. A skilled user of Domination will find they are able to forge bonds with the various Chaos Lord's upon the Chaos Plane, and by doing so grant the minions those Lords will send greater freedom when summoned(*).<p>You may only support up to four bonds at a time, so choose wisely. Bonds may only be forged in the presence of the Lord you seek to bond with; they may be severed from anywhere.</p><p>* Entities benefitting from a prime bond will act passively in addition to retaining their active effects. See the ability files for relevant details for each entity.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=[[Piridon]]
 |description=Piridon, the shapechanger.
 |lessons=738
 |syntax=ORDER DOPPLEGANGER <command>
 |required=
 |target=Adventurers and room
 |cooldown=
 |detail=When you summon Piridon, he will send to you a doppleganger. The doppleganger will look like you, though it must be referred to as 'doppleganger'. The doppleganger is much different from other entities in that it may be remotely commanded.<p>'''CHANNEL <ab>''' : Allows you to channel certain Occult abilities through your doppleganger. These include: Ague, Devolution, Eldrichmists, Quicken, Shrivel, Timewarp, and Warp.<br>'''CLOAK''' : Masks your doppleganger's entry and exit.<br>'''EXITS''' : Shows the exits from the room your doppleganger is in.<br>'''LOOK''' : Your doppleganger looks at the room it is in.<br>'''MOVE <dir>''' : Your doppleganger moves in a specific direction.<br>'''RETURN''' : Your doppleganger returns to you.<br>'''SEEK <who>''' : Your doppleganger seeks a specific adventurer. If he is flying, it will go and wait underneath. Trees present no obstacle to this.</p><p>Special note about channeling: the channel to your doppleganger is a two-way link, however briefly it may be in operation. Any backlash from an attack channeled through your doppleganger has a very high likelihood of continuing through that link and harming you directly.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=[[Glaaki]]
 |description=Glaaki, the Eldritch Ascendant
 |lessons=1738
 |syntax=SUMMON GLAAKI<br>COMMAND ABOMINATION AT <target>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=Ancient; formidable; greatest of the Chaos Lords. The Eldritch Ascendant is all of these and many things left best unspoken. Ruthlessly pragmatic, Glaaki tore his rule from the hands of those thought untouchable. Any who pact with him beware, for slights can fester a thousand years or more. <p>To those granted his grace, the Ascendant shall bestow the use of one of his abominable servants. This avatar, when commanded to violate a victim whose aura has been made sufficiently vulnerable to external assault, shall determine the fundamental nature of the target and grant the occultist the greatest weapon of all; knowledge of their subject's true name.</p><p>(*) an aura can be made sufficiently vulnerable through the cleanseaura ability in Occultism.<br>(**) truenames gained in this way have a much shorter lifespan than those gained through standard methods.</p>
}}
